name: Phu Day
kicker: Mother Goddess complex at Vụ Bản
summary: Give a day to Phủ Dầy, about 15 km southwest, the festival UNESCO names for the Mother Goddesses of the Three Realms. The ministry prints the start of lunar month 3. One article’s solar window, 9–14 April, is not a fixed date. A gate hour and a ticket were not printed. Check on arrival.
getThere: About 15 km southwest of the city. Minutes were not printed.

notice.title: The solar dates do not repeat on the page
notice.body: The ministry prints the start of lunar month 3. One article maps 9–14 April to the 3rd–8th of that lunar month and does not say those solar days repeat. The next solar date is check on arrival. A gate hour and a ticket were not printed.

body: Walk the Mother Goddess complex at thôn Tiên Hương and thôn Vân Cát, xã Kim Thái, huyện Vụ Bản. Phủ Tiên Hương is nearly 7,500 m², 19 buildings, 81 bays. Phủ Vân Cát is about 1 km east, nearly 3,600 m². UNESCO’s 2016 listing names Phủ Dầy as a festival of the Mother Goddesses of the Three Realms, and names Liễu Hạnh the Mother of the World. Ranked a national relic by Decision 09-VH/QĐ of 21 February 1975. The ministry calls the complex one of two special national relics in the province, with the Trần ground. Nearly 20 sites on the VietnamPlus account, centered on Phủ Tiên Hương, Phủ Vân Cát, and the mausoleum.

The festival brings processions, a torch procession at Phủ Tiên Hương, chầu văn, and human chess. A minute for a complex of that size was not printed. A gate hour and a ticket were not printed. Check on arrival. A resort brand inside the hills is not the sight. The phủ is the sight.
